meta.description: Unofficial companion for Plakoro matches: translate your Wazacards, pick your 4 moves and track your counters.

home.intro: Read your Japanese Wazacards in English, pick your 4 moves, check your rival's moves and track your counters while you play.

footer.unofficial: Unofficial fan project. Not affiliated with Pokémon, Bandai or Nintendo.

team.title: Pick 4 moves
team.hint: Tap a card to pick it. Open "Show effects" to read what it does on each Charakoro face.

rival.title: Who are you playing against?
rival.hint: Pick your rival's Pokémon to check their moves during the match.
rival.missingSetup: First pick your Pokémon and your 4 moves.

table.title: My table
table.endTurnNeedsMove: Tap the move you used to end your turn.
table.markUsed: Tap the card you used this turn.
table.blocked: Blocked: you used it last turn
table.invalid: The match setup is not valid.
table.firstTurnHint: Turn 1: if you go first, roll only 2 Enekoro.
table.faceNeedsMove: First tap the move you used.
table.faceNeedsRivalMove: First tap the move your rival used.
table.markRivalMove: Tap the card your rival played to read its effect.

about.title: About
about.intro: Oskoro is a free, ad-free, unofficial fan project made to support physical Plakoro matches.
disclaimer: It is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Bandai, Bandai Spirits, The Pokémon Company, Nintendo, Creatures Inc. or GAME FREAK inc.
Plakoro, Pokémon and character names are trademarks of their respective owners. ©Pokémon. ©Nintendo/Creatures Inc./GAME FREAK inc.
Oskoro does not use official artwork, logos or card layouts.
If a rights holder requests that any content be changed or removed, the request will be handled promptly.
about.dataCredit: Card data and translations: {plakorodb} by Jollto and contributors, licensed under {license}. Text was adapted to JSON (normalized structure, fan-translation flag and English fallback). Non-commercial use.
about.fanNames: Move names marked as "Fan translation" are community proposals and may change if an official translation is released.
about.privacy: Oskoro has no accounts, cookies or analytics. Match counters are stored only in your browser, in this tab, and are deleted when you close it.
